items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: And I got to the... and answered the phone and he said, 'This is Cy Jones.' ... He said, 'Oh, I need a bass player bad, I gotta have a bass player.'

ctx.x: So what kind of a call did you get?
Now, the word had got out that I had a bass. All right. And there was a guy there by the name of Cy Jones, was a tenor player. And Cy Jones, he wasn't a tenor player's tenor player by no means.
